article_title: The one thing you need to do to succeed - according to top bosses

tasks.prompt: What overall message connects the advice from the six business leaders?
options: Success depends mainly on having a perfect CV
Mindset, curiosity, communication and willingness to take opportunities can matter more than flawless credentials
Candidates should avoid asking questions during interviews
Workers should specialise narrowly and reject unfamiliar tasks
tasks.correct_answer: Mindset, curiosity, communication and willingness to take opportunities can matter more than flawless credentials
tasks.explanation_hebrew: העצות מדגישות גישה, סקרנות, תקשורת ונכונות לנסות דברים חדשים יותר מאשר קורות חיים מושלמים בלבד.

tasks.prompt: What interview question does Charlie Bowes-Lyon recommend asking?
options: How quickly can I replace my manager?
Why did the previous employee fail?
What does success in this job look like?
Can I avoid working with a team?
tasks.correct_answer: What does success in this job look like?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: Bowes-Lyon ממליץ לשאול כיצד נראית הצלחה בתפקיד, משום שמועמדים שאין להם שאלות כמעט אינם מתקבלים לדעתו.

tasks.prompt: What does “naysayers” mean in Charlotte Tilbury's advice?
options: People who discourage ideas or say they will not work
Customers who buy products immediately
Mentors who teach technical skills
Interviewers who ask open questions
tasks.correct_answer: People who discourage ideas or say they will not work
tasks.explanation_hebrew: naysayers הם אנשים שליליים שאומרים שרעיון לא יעבוד או שמנסים להציב מגבלות.

tasks.prompt: Why does Marcia Kilgore advise taking “a breath or five” before responding?
options: To make a response faster than everyone else's
To avoid listening to the question
To hide a lack of experience
To give a considered rather than merely immediate answer
tasks.correct_answer: To give a considered rather than merely immediate answer
tasks.explanation_hebrew: קילגור מדגישה שתגובה אינה חייבת להיות מיידית, אך עליה להיות שקולה ומבוססת על הקשבה.

tasks.prompt: Why can taking a role outside your comfort zone strengthen a CV?
options: It removes the need to work with other people
It can build broader experience and resilience through unfamiliar challenges
It guarantees promotion without performance
It prevents employers from asking about skills
tasks.correct_answer: It can build broader experience and resilience through unfamiliar challenges
tasks.explanation_hebrew: התנסות מאתגרת ולא מוכרת יכולה להרחיב את הניסיון, לבנות חוסן ולהוסיף רוחב מקצועי לקורות החיים.

tasks.prompt: What does it mean to “mirror the job description” in an application?
options: Copy the entire advertisement without changing it
Send the application to competing companies
Clearly match your relevant skills and experience to the employer's stated needs
Use AI to remove your personal voice
tasks.correct_answer: Clearly match your relevant skills and experience to the employer's stated needs
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכוונה היא להראות בבירור כיצד הכישורים והניסיון שלך מתאימים לדרישות המפורטות במודעת התפקיד.

tasks.prompt: Compare the qualities that Charlie Bowes-Lyon, Marcia Kilgore and Anabel Kindersley value in candidates.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין לפחות שתי נקודות מכל מנהל ולהבחין בין גישה, סקרנות, תקשורת, כנות ואינטליגנציה רגשית.
expected_points: Bowes-Lyon values attitude more than a perfect skill set
He believes skills can be taught but attitude cannot
He expects candidates to ask thoughtful interview questions
Kilgore values curiosity and willingness to be useful
She looks for people who ask questions and roll up their sleeves
Kilgore says careful communication is crucial
Kindersley recommends saying yes to new opportunities
She values honesty about experience
She looks for emotional intelligence as well as intellectual ability

tasks.prompt: Explain how the leaders turn setbacks, discomfort and risk into opportunities for development.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשר בין עצותיהם של Tilbury, Kindersley ו־Nunn ולהסביר את מנגנון הלמידה מן האתגר.
expected_points: Tilbury reframes mistakes and setbacks as chances to rethink and improve
She says challenges made her a stronger leader
Kindersley advises accepting opportunities even when they feel uncomfortable
Her varied career grew from trying different roles
Nunn recommends work outside one's comfort zone
He was frightened by retail roles but gained valuable experience
Unfamiliar experiences can build resilience
Taking calculated risks can broaden a CV and reveal new abilities

tasks.prompt: Summarise the six leaders' main recommendations for succeeding at work or in recruitment.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול עצה מרכזית מכל אחד מן הדוברים ולהציג מסר מאחד ברור.
expected_points: Charlotte Tilbury says not to accept other people's limits and to learn from setbacks
Charlie Bowes-Lyon prioritises attitude and thoughtful interview questions
Marcia Kilgore values curiosity and considered communication
Anabel Kindersley recommends saying yes to opportunities and being honest
Charlie Nunn values curiosity, resilience, teamwork and learning outside the comfort zone
James Reed says applicants should show how they solve an employer's needs
Reed advises matching skills to the job description
AI should strengthen an application rather than replace personal judgement or voice

tasks.prompt: Write a concise answer to the interview question “Why should we hire you?” using principles from the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב באנגלית תשובה אמינה וספציפית שמקשרת בין דרישות המשרה לבין תרומת המועמד, בלי קלישאות או ניסיון מומצא.
expected_points: Identify a relevant skill or experience
Connect it directly to a need in the job description
Explain how the candidate can help solve an employer's problem
Show curiosity and willingness to learn
Demonstrate teamwork or communication
Include one honest example rather than unsupported claims
Show a constructive attitude toward challenges
Preserve the candidate's own voice
Do not claim AI-generated achievements as personal experience
